description: This file implements WebSocket-based communication for a gateway system in a client application. It defines protocols for WebSocket tasks and sessions, manages the connection lifecycle, reconnection logic, request/response handling, authentication, and heartbeat ping/pong maintenance, as well as processing incoming messages, including connect challenges and tick events.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: Protocol defining WebSocket task operations such as resume, cancel, send, receive, and ping.

classes.name: WebSocketSessioning
classes.description: Protocol for creating WebSocket tasks given a URL.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: A type-erased wrapper around WebSocketTasking, providing convenience methods.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: A wrapper for WebSocketSessioning to facilitate dependency injection or mocking.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scope, capabilities, commands, permissions, client info, and device identity flag.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: Enumeration representing various authentication sources (device token, shared token, bootstrap token, password, none).

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: Actor managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, including connection, reconnection, message handling, heartbeat, and authentication for the gateway communication.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the WebSocket connection, handling authentication and initial handshake.

methods.name: startKeepalive
methods.description: Starts the heartbeat task to keep the connection alive using periodic ping messages.

methods.name: keepaliveLoop
methods.description: Loop sending periodic pings to maintain NAT/proxy state and detect connection issues.

methods.name: sendConnect
methods.description: Constructs and sends the connect request frame with necessary authentication and device info.

methods.name: startWatchdog
methods.description: Initiates the watchdog task that monitors connection health and triggers reconnections.

methods.name: watchdogLoop
methods.description: Periodic loop attempting reconnections with exponential backoff if disconnected.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the connection and cancels all ongoing tasks, marking the actor as disconnected.
